h1: Pricing and discounts, updated across the catalog
overview: Price changes touch many places: product prices, compare-at prices, variant prices, discount codes and automatic discounts. We plan the change with you, set up a sale or a new price list, test the discount rules in a real cart and schedule the start and end where your platform allows. You get a sheet of old and new prices so you can check any product quickly.

faq: Can you set prices for different countries?
Where your platform supports market pricing, yes. We set it up with the exchange rules you choose. Tell us the countries and currencies, and whether prices should include tax.
How do you avoid pricing mistakes?
We back up current prices first, show you the new ones in a sheet and test discount stacking in a real cart before the sale starts. If a rule behaves oddly, we fix it before launch.
Do you decide what my prices should be?
No, you set the numbers or the rule, such as a percentage or a margin. We can point out risks, like a discount that stacks with another, but pricing strategy stays with you.
Do the discount rules work with my apps?
Usually, yes. Some discount or bundle apps change how discounts combine, so we test with the apps you actually use. Any paid app is billed to you by its maker.
